description: This file defines the PHP client class for interacting with the AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method signatures for retrieving entitlements, both synchronously and asynchronously.

classes.name: MarketplaceEntitlementServiceClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with AWS Marketplace Entitlement Service, extending the core AwsClient.

methods.name: getEntitlements
methods.description: Retrieves entitlements for AWS Marketplace items synchronously.

methods.name: getEntitlementsAsync
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous request to retrieve entitlements from AWS Marketplace.
